name: trackiq-amazon-competitor-teardown
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Competitor Listing Teardown
summary: Puts one Amazon product page side by side with the three or four beating it on the shelf — title structure, image count, bullet construction, price and price per unit, coupons, rating and review depth, and rank — then says what to change and in what order. Compares content, not slots.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection; the public page is the only source for this data.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.
